package.name: humanoid_walk_nn
package.description: HNN: ROS Noetic bipedal humanoid (indoor walking + mapping/navigation) assignment. Simplified linear-inverted-pendulum balance on top of a step-phase gait in the hall / warehouse / obstacle indoor scenes with pillars, crates and moving carts; keyboard teleoperation, 360-degree lidar / GNSS / IMU / joint-encoder / depth-camera sensors, balance and fall monitoring, occupancy-grid SLAM, A* navigation, and pure-NumPy neural networks for perception, planning, control and end-to-end camera walking.
